# A spec's gate counts as approved only when the user created its decision record (first version's…

A spec's gate counts as approved only when the user created its decision record (first version's actor_kind = user); an agent's shows as agent-recorded with Confirm, and never opens the next gate

From the automated security review of 0.152.0: any agent could record_add a decision with links.gate and pass a gate. to-spec now says the user approves in the panel, or the agent records a chat yes that the user confirms there. Shipped in 0.153.1.
